steps.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_payment_options (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, company_id INT NOT NULL, local_branch_id INT NOT NULL, tran_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL, ce_id INT DEFAULT NULL, wallet_id INT DEFAULT NULL, reward_credit_id INT DEFAULT NULL, ce_invoice_id VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT NULL, ce_type ENUM('IN','OUT') DEFAULT NULL, payment_type ENUM('CASH','DEBIT','CREDIT','CHEQUE','DRAFT','BANK_DEPOSIT','EWIRE','WALLET','LOAN','REWARD_CREDIT') NOT NULL, payment_amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, payment_type_number VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL, source_country_id INT NOT NULL, real_account_id INT DEFAULT NULL, real_account_type ENUM('LOCAL','HQ') DEFAULT NULL, date_added DATETIME NOT NULL, event_type ENUM('MONEY_TRANSFER','CURRENCY_EXCHANGE','WALLET') DEFAULT NULL, KEY(company_id), KEY(real_account_type), KEY(tran_id), KEY(ce_id), KEY(wallet_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_wallet (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, wallet_unique_id VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL, company_id INT NOT NULL, branch_admin_id INT DEFAULT NULL, emp_id INT DEFAULT NULL, emp_type ENUM('SUPER_ADMIN','ADMIN','AGENT_ADMIN','AGENT','OVER_AGENT_ADMIN','OVER_AGENT') DEFAULT NULL, cus_id BIGINT NOT NULL, tran_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL, beehive_id INT DEFAULT NULL, type ENUM('DEPOSIT','WITHDRAW','TRANSACTION') NOT NULL, sub_type ENUM('MONEY_TRANSFER','BEEHIVE_DEPOSIT') DEFAULT NULL, credit_in DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT NULL, credit_out DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT NULL, currency VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, date_added DATETIME NOT NULL, note VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL, location ENUM('DIRECT') DEFAULT NULL, is_approved ENUM('0','1') NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', idebit_issconf VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL, idebit_issname VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL, idebit_isstrack2 VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL, KEY(cus_id), KEY(company_id), KEY(branch_admin_id), KEY(emp_id), KEY(tran_id), KEY(beehive_id))
